reviews.shade: FATION Nosca9 Trouble Serum Mask Sheet 4ea Set (+1ea)
reviews.text: This is a great mask for calming the skin redness and hydrating a dry irritated skin. Love it .
reviews.zh: 呢款面膜好適合舒緩皮膚發紅，同埋為乾燥、易刺激嘅皮膚補水。好鍾意！

reviews.shade: FATION Nosca9 Trouble Serum Mask Sheet 4ea Set (+1ea)
reviews.text: It’s a good sheet mask. I like the Fation trouble care line, but I think in the future I would just buy the serum bottle.
reviews.zh: 係一款好嘅面膜。我鍾意 Fation 嘅 trouble care 系列，不過我諗將來我可能會直接買精華樽。

reviews.shade: FATION Nosca9 Trouble Serum Mask Sheet 4ea Set (+1ea)
reviews.text: This mask is very hydrating and calming. It helps reduce redness and leaves my skin feeling soft and refreshed. Perfect for sensitive or acne-prone skin. I’ll definitely repurchase!
reviews.zh: 呢款面膜保濕同鎮定效果都好好。有助減少發紅，令皮膚感覺柔軟同清爽。啱敏感肌或者易長痘嘅皮膚用。我一定會回購！

reviews.shade: FATION Nosca9 Trouble Serum Mask Sheet 4ea Set (+1ea)
reviews.text: The serum is very soothing for sensitive skin so I bought the mask as well! Recommended 👍🏻
reviews.zh: 呢款精華對敏感肌好舒緩，所以我都買咗面膜！推薦 👍🏻

reviews.shade: FATION Nosca9 Trouble Serum Mask Sheet 4ea Set (+1ea)
reviews.text: It's hydrating and comfortable to wear, but I didn't see significant effects to my active breakouts after a few uses.
reviews.zh: 保濕，敷落都舒服，但係用咗幾次，我冇見到對我活躍期嘅痘痘有明顯效果。

reviews.shade: FATION Nosca9 Trouble Serum Mask Sheet 4ea Set (+1ea)
reviews.text: Best mask ever and dare I say, my ride and die. I use it at least once a week or whenever my face needs the extra TLC. I use tretinoin and this mask helps with irritation and dryness.
reviews.zh: 最好嘅面膜，我敢講，係我嘅死忠好拍檔。我每星期最少用一次，或者喺面部需要額外 TLC（悉心護理）嗰陣用。我用緊 tretinoin（維A酸），呢款面膜幫我緩解刺激同乾燥。

reviews.shade: FATION Nosca9 Trouble Serum Mask Sheet 4ea Set (+1ea)
reviews.text: I just used this once, no obvious improvement on the acnes, but feel calming and moisturing
reviews.zh: 我只用咗一次，痘痘冇明顯改善，但係感覺好鎮定同保濕。

reviews.shade: FATION Nosca9 Trouble Serum Mask Sheet 4ea Set (+1ea)
reviews.text: This is a repurchase - I like to have this mask on when my skin is in trouble like a pimple comes out or feeling irritated after sun.
reviews.zh: 呢個係回購——我皮膚出問題嗰陣，例如長咗粒痘，或者曬完太陽覺得刺激，我都鍾意敷呢款面膜。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
